newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy machine tool production seen rising in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italy machine tool production seen rising in 1996.

text.p: Italian machine tool sales and production is set to see an increase in 1996, according to the union of Italian machine tool makers (UCIMU).
Production in 1996 is expected to rise by 5.4 percent to be worth 5,630 billion lire, while sales will rise 4.9 percent to be valued at 4,590 billion lire.
According to a UCIMU statement, it sees further progress in orders over the next few months after first half 1996 orders rose 35.1 percent compared to the same period in 1995.
